__COMMENT_METAL5: Metal 5 is reserved for the Tiny Tapeout power grid. RT_MAX_LAYER is held at met4 so the macro leaves met5 free for integration.
__COMMENT_DIE_AREA: 190 x 130 um. Sized from the real LibreLane synthesis area of 8012.7 um2 (NOT the 6945 um2 that plain yosys reports). Core margins remove ~29% and repair buffering grows it further; 150 x 130 gave effective utilisation 0.739 and failed detailed placement with DPL-0036.
__COMMENT_CLOCK: 20 ns = 50 MHz, the Tiny Tapeout harness maximum. SPI SCK is oversampled by this clock, so keep SCK below about 5 MHz.
